#+title: habshe-emacs — windows and buffer display
#+author: A. Shehab (habshehabshe)

Where buffers go when displayed. The policy: never split, never
pop up — reuse the window already showing the buffer if there is
one, else use the selected window. This is also where buffrt's
display routing will integrate later, so it stays isolated.

#+begin_src emacs-lisp :tangle "../lisp/my-windows.el"
  ;;; my-windows.el --- GENERATED from org/windows.org — do not edit -*- lexical-binding: t; -*-
  ;;; Commentary: Buffer display policy. Future buffrt routing lives here.

  (defgroup my-windows nil
    "Window and buffer display policy for my Emacs configuration.")

  (setopt display-buffer-base-action
          '((display-buffer-reuse-window display-buffer-same-window) . nil))

  (provide 'my-windows)
#+end_src
